# Provenance

`input.hea` and `monitor.dat` are derived from sample 01 in the MedOmni family sample set, an excerpt of one deidentified record in the MIMIC-IV Waveform Database 0.1.0 (open access on PhysioNet) with leads II, V and aVR. The 62.4725 Hz frames of the excerpt were resampled by four to the declared 249.89 Hz family rate.

License: ODbL 1.0 (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/), the MIMIC-IV Waveform Database's license; this derived excerpt retains it. Attribution: MIMIC-IV Waveform Database, PhysioNet. Retain this notice with the files.
